Players Committee card image of [[Darth Vader's Lightsaber (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on Vader. While on Vader, may not be stolen and he is power +1. Instead of firing, may cancel the immunity to attrition of a Jedi present. May target a character for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/darthvaderslightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
